findings.summary: The Idle state node is entirely missing from the ASCII rendering.
findings.evidence:
SVG has a node with rect and label

Idle

(id="...state-Idle-2"), but asciiText shows only blank space (" ▼ ▲ │") where the Idle box and its border/label should be.

findings.summary: The arrowhead on the edge from the start marker into Idle is missing.
findings.evidence: SVG edge0 has marker-end="url(#...barbEnd)" and case-000's identical diagram renders "▼" before the Idle box, but case-002's asciiText goes straight from "         │" to "╭────────────────╮" with no arrowhead glyph.

findings.summary: Every transition arrow points the wrong direction (up instead of down).
findings.evidence: SVG paths all run downward with marker-end barbs pointing down (e.g. edge0 M54.957,22...L54.957,72), and case-000's identical diagram renders "▼" at each transition, but case-003's asciiText uses "▲" at every single transition point (after start, into/out of Idle, Active, Done, and before the end marker), reversing the apparent flow direction throughout.
